title: LinkedIn Impersonation
scenario: A fake executive profile asks employees to discuss a confidential opportunity.

answers.A: Act immediately because the request sounds urgent and important.
answers.B: Reply to the sender asking them to confirm the request.
answers.C: Use the approved company system or verified process.
answers.D: Escalate to IT, finance, HR, legal, or your manager through official channels.

explanation: LinkedIn Impersonation: the trap is to move you from a trusted channel to a fake page. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Sensitive company matters should stay in official channels.
